BrochureContent.Content:
Tastefully Updated Three Bedroom Detached Bungalow 

Kinsella Estates are delighted to present this superb three-bedroom detached residence to the market, ideally positioned within the highly regarded coastal development of Woodland in Courtown, Co. Wexford.

This attractive residence, constructed of block construction in 1979 to a high standard, has been lovingly maintained and carefully preserved, offering a home of enduring quality and timeless appeal. The property offers ample parking to the front along with a private driveway.

Entrance Hall: A welcoming entrance hall featuring elegant tiled, creating an immediate sense of warmth and setting the tone for the beautifully presented accommodation throughout. Kitchen / Dining Room: A beautifully proportioned, light-filled space thoughtfully designed for modern family living. The kitchen is finished with tiled flooring and a stylish tiled splashback, seamlessly flowing into the dining area to create a practical yet inviting setting for both everyday living and entertaining.

Living Room: A warm and inviting reception room featuring quality timber flooring and a charming timber fireplace as its focal point. Double doors open into the generous sunroom, creating a wonderful sense of space and allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the room. 

Master Bedroom: A spacious and well-appointed principal bedroom complete with timber flooring and the added luxury of a private ensuite, providing a peaceful and comfortable retreat. Bedroom 2: A generously proportioned double bedroom featuring timber flooring and contemporary slide robes, offering excellent storage and a bright, airy atmosphere. Bedroom 3: A bright and comfortable bedroom with timber flooring, perfectly suited as a family bedroom, guest room, or home office. Wet Room: Beautifully finished with full-height tiling, the wet room offers a sleek, contemporary design with both style and practicality.

Outside:
To the rear, the property enjoys a spacious sunroom overlooking a low-maintenance concrete patio area, providing an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing. To the front, the landscaped garden is designed for ease of maintenance and is enhanced by an attractive selection of mature trees and shrubs, creating a welcoming approach to the home.

Woolands enjoys an enviable location within walking distance of local shops, schools, churches, and the nearby beach, offering a wonderful coastal lifestyle. Courtown Village and Harbour are within walking distances, while the vibrant town of Gorey is only a 5-minute drive, providing an excellent selection of retail, dining, leisure facilities, and transport links. The M11 motorway to Dublin is easily accessible at Exit 23 on the Courtown Road which is only a few minutes' drive also.
